856-5776-6277-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another Food.
856-5776-6277-8227.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.

5034-5660-6769-6797.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5034-5660-6769-6797.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sol Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

512-3814-4091.easyPrerequisites: Argothian Elder and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-3814-4091.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-3814-4091.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-6026--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-6026--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

240-3899-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-5231-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1981-2415-5231-6458.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Repeat.

2073-2438-7877-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Voyager Glidecar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2313-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1322-2034-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

4968-6919-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
4968-6919-7803.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Brad Boimler.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4968-6919-7803.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

2034-3055-3953-7733.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Contract Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Contract Hero dies, Mazzy's second ability and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Mazzy trigger, exiling Gift of Immortality with the ability to cast it until end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Contract Hero from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Contract Hero enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Gift of Immortality from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Contract Hero.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

486-2388-6587-7012.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
486-2388-6587-7012.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7322.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1636-2034-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Intruder Alarm triggers three times. Resolve the Intruder Alarm triggers from this step and step 2, untapping all creatures four times.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

38-5220-6900-7286.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

224-1283-1999-6871.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {1}, tapping it and returning Chromatic Orrery from the battlefield to your hand, putting Chromatic Orrery onto the battlefield.
When Chromatic Orrery enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, as Chromatic Orrery is a land due to Toph, untapping Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

4017-4094-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-4094-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 2.

567-2034-3490-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-2034-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-4211-4927.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-5260-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5260-6798.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5260-6798.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

24-918-6899.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Donna Noble instead of you due to With Great Power... if you chose the largest number.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-918-6899.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

3698-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 5.

586-5258-5618-6121-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3918-4222-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
3918-4222-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

565-1858-6201--118.notablePrerequisites: You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
565-1858-6201--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

803-2557-3951-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
803-2557-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

759-1247-1876-5963-6549.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Grove of the Burnwillows to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1525-2146-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

1069-1115-1232-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1115-1232-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

224-1525-2692-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-2692-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Felidar Retreat trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

2226-2397-5125.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2226-2397-5125.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-5125.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying {2}{R}{G}.
When Sparkcaster enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sparkcaster triggers, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Sparkcaster triggers, dealing 2 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's other abilities.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying its mana cost.
When Sparkcaster enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4-2334-3258.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows either from your hand or from exile by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Hoarding Broodlord.
When Hoarding Broodlord enters the battlefield, it and Soulherder's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hoarding Broodlord trigger, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and exiling it.
Repeat each turn.

486-678-4497-4853.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
486-678-4497-4853.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Slobad to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Slobad.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Dross Scorpion by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

826-1246-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Amoeboid Changeling.
Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1246-2178.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's first ability by tapping it, causing any creature an opponent controls to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Spirit Mirror by paying {0}, destroying the opponent's creature.
The creature dies, triggering Amoeboid Changeling, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1228-5136.notablePrerequisites:
Quietus Spike attached to Goblin Sharpshooter.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-5136.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target creature.
That creature dies from lethal damage due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch ability.
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for each creature opponents control and whenever an opponent controls a creature.
